title: SportsDataIO trial: verified access, integration value and modeling limits
conclusion: Trial supports schema and integration evaluation. It does not support a valid predictive-quality comparison or authentic pregame player-feature training.

projected_minutes.reason: dictionary marks Minutes and Seconds scrambled

nba_additions.injury_fields: InjuryStatus, InjuryBodyPart, InjuryNotes, InjuryStartDate; status/body/notes marked scrambled. 90 injured-player records, not 90 verified current injuries.
nba_additions.lineups: Projected and confirmed lineup structures for 10 games; no evidence that these future lineups were already confirmed. Trial correctness not certified.
nba_additions.advanced_fields: PlayerEfficiencyRating, UsageRatePercentage, AssistsPercentage, StealsPercentage, BlocksPercentage, rebound percentages and TurnOversPercentage present but NULL in all 348 projection rows. They do not supply usable advanced-player ratings.
nba_additions.baker: Unverified. Coverage describes a separate direct engine JSON Query API; no approved GET-only NBA BAKER route or account entitlement established. Legacy projections are not BAKER.

identity_review.source: github_run_summary.json; joins performed in-memory by audit code using matching home/away team abbreviations
identity_review.unmatched_reason: Only seven of ten games matched exact team abbreviations. Remaining aliases or mismatches were not guessed.
identity_review.player_reason: SDIO roster has 524 unique PlayerID and NbaDotComPlayerID values. BDL's sampled 100 active-player rows expose its own id but no nba_id/nba_player_id. No independently corroborated player crosswalk. Do not equate integer IDs or use name-only joins.
identity_review.coverage_caveat: BDL active-player and injury responses each have next_cursor; samples are incomplete. Non-null external-ID strings are not automatically valid cross-provider IDs.

limits.sportsdataio_exact_numeric_quota: Unknown: no quota/remaining/reset/Retry-After headers returned in the allowlisted captures; official portal says small daily call limit without numeric value.
limits.sportsdataio_observed: 11 successful calls; no 429. This establishes a successful batch, not daily capacity or remaining quota.
limits.balldontlie_headers: x-ratelimit-limit=60, remaining 59/58/57, reset=1793308681. Do not infer subscription tier or total daily entitlement from this header alone.
limits.scrambling: Free trial uses scrambled data. NBA dictionary explicitly marks Minutes, Seconds, InjuryStatus, InjuryBodyPart, InjuryNotes and many statistical projections as scrambled. Names and IDs may be marked nonscrambled per field; do not infer all fields are fake or all are authentic.
limits.delay: No exact account-specific trial latency or artificial delay verified. Separate Discovery Lab is next-day delayed; that rule was not applied to this trial.
limits.soccer: Competition 3 projections returned 200 with empty array for 2026-10-30. Competition listing returned 93 rows; listing a competition does not grant its projections. Official trial documentation restricts soccer to UEFA Champions League. Turkish Super Lig projection entitlement not established.
limits.expiration: Account UI previously displayed start October 29, 2026 and expiration None. No guarantee of unlimited future access.
limits.rights: Official portal describes free trial for integration evaluation and says scrambled trial data cannot be used for analysis or display. Permission for model training, retained authentic snapshots or live Kalshi/prediction-market use not established; commercial prediction-market marketing is not this account's license.

timing.timezone: Provider Updated and DateTime fields documented as US Eastern time; HTTP Date is GMT. On October 29 Eastern is UTC-4.
timing.interpretation: Updated is last record modification, not first publication. HTTP Date is response date; DateTime is scheduled event time. None certify historical pregame availability.

historical.result: Date-addressable historical projections exist for this date; latest Updates extend into October 29. No version-at-cutoff parameter or archived publication sequence verified. Cannot use these as pregame vintages.

timing.documented_refresh: NBA Legacy projections documented five days ahead; game-day customization by 9 am EST, updates every 15 minutes until tipoff. API recommended call intervals: projections 5 minutes, lineups 3 minutes. Publishing cadence, cache interval and account request quota are distinct.

research_lab.gate: Reject all trial player performance values from training/evaluation. No predictive advantage measured.
research_lab.allowed_result: Integration schema/provenance evidence and seven reviewed game identity pairs only. No synthetic data relabeled authentic.
research_lab.bdl_comparison: Current run confirmed games, active players and injuries. Prior run 40937660925 confirmed completed-game stats, returned 401 for v2 advanced stats and lineups. Those denied endpoints were not re-probed here. BDL documents lineups only once a game begins, so that feed is not a pregame lineup substitute.
research_lab.next: Obtain an approved authentic unscrambled sample with retention/modeling rights, timestamped pregame versions and a vetted player identity crosswalk. Then capture prospective paired same-game/cutoff features and apply existing lab gates.

scope.master_plan: Sports, weather and finance remain in scope. This is one sports-provider feasibility audit, not a change to the platform vision.
